items.title: Sales Director Argentina
items.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales to lead and grow our commercial strategy at Futbol Sites . This is a leadership position for a senior professional with a strong network and proven track record in digital media advertising . The ideal candidate combines deep market knowledge with strong commercial expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to build long-term relationships with advertisers, agencies, brands, and strategic partners. Based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for leading your team to drive revenue growth across the market, developing new business opportunities, strengthening key client relationships, and leading a high-performing sales team. You will play a key role in positioning Futbol Sites as a leading sports media partner and identifying new opportunities across the evolving digital advertising ecosystem. What You'll Do Commercial Leadership & Strategy Instill a partnership-first mindset across the team, coaching reps to prioritize long-term relationship depth and strategic account growth over transactional, campaign-by-campaign selling. Define and execute the commercial strategy for the market, aligned with Futbol Sites' regional and global objectives. Identify new revenue opportunities across digital media, sports, football, branded content, programmatic, sponsorships, and other relevant commercial solutions. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics, advertiser needs, agency structures, competitors, and emerging digital media trends. Contribute to the evolution of Futbol Sites' commercial offering and go-to-market strategy. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the commercial team, setting clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations. Build a high-performing, collaborative, and results-oriented sales culture. Support team members in developing strategic accounts, closing complex opportunities, and expanding existing business. Monitor team performance, pipeline development, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets. Identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities, processes, and commercial best practices across the team. Business Development & Sales Lead the identification and acquisition of new clients, advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners. Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and the sports ecosystem. Personally manage and develop strategic and high-value accounts. Lead major commercial pitches, negotiations, and partnership discussions. Develop innovative and customized commercial proposals that combine Futbol Sites' digital media assets, audience, content, and sports expertise. Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and business growth targets. Market & Industry Leadership Maintain a strong network and active presence within the digital media, advertising, sports, and fútbol industries . Represent Futbol Sites at relevant industry events, meetings, conferences, and client activities. Stay ahead of changes in digital advertising, media consumption, audience behavior, sports marketing, and competitive offerings. Bring market intelligence and new commercial ideas into the organization. Identify opportunities to position Futbol Sites at the forefront of the digital sports media ecosystem. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Marketing, Content, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Programmatic, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of commercial initiatives. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to share market insights and identify opportunities across Argentina Ensure that client expectations and commercial commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered. What We're Looking For Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and developing commercial or sales teams, preferably within digital media, advertising, sports, or technology companies. Industry Expertise: Strong background in the digital media and advertising industry , with a solid understanding of the sports and/or fútbol ecosystem. Commercial Track Record: Demonstrated success in developing new business, managing strategic accounts, negotiating complex deals, and consistently achieving revenue targets. Industry Network: Established relationships with advertisers, brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and/or key players within the sports ecosystem. Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of digital advertising, media sales, branded content, sponsorships, audience monetization, and current industry trends. Leadership Skills: Strong ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams while maintaining a high-performance culture. Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate market opportunities into actionable commercial strategies and measurable business results. Communication & Negotiation: Excellent presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and decision-makers. Analytical & Business Acumen: Strong understanding of sales pipelines, forecasting, commercial KPIs, revenue performance, and business planning. Tools: Strong proficiency in PowerPoint/Keynote, Excel, CRM platforms, and other commercial tools. Education: University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field is preferred. Languages: Advanced English is preferred. Location: Based in Buenos Aires with full-time availability. What Success Looks Like Consistent growth in commercial revenue and market share. A strong and well-developed sales pipeline. Successful acquisition and retention of strategic clients and partners. A high-performing and engaged commercial team. Strong positioning and visibility for Futbol Sites within the digital media and sports industry. Continuous identification of new business opportunities and innovative ways to monetize our audiences and content. Lead a commercial team that thinks and sells like partnership builders and generates strategic value of the relationships they own.

items.title: Account Manager
items.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? We are looking for an exceptional Account Manager to join our ever-growing #PlaytechWorld. As a market leader in the gambling and financial trading industries, Playtech is at the forefront of delivering business intelligence-driven gambling software, services, content, and platform technology. If you are passionate about the gaming industry and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you! Your influential mission. You will... Be on top of customer business models, including marketing strategies (e.g., bonuses, admin usage). Manage day-to-day commercial contact between Playtech customers and internal stakeholders. Drive customer performance and revenue growth through strategic recommendations using KPI(s) & benchmark analysis. Promote tasks internally, including development requests and initiation of new projects. Assist the Regional Director in working on group-wide deals. Ensure customers are aware of and utilize new Playtech products. Provide customers with appropriate marketing materials for promoting all products. Maximize revenues and profits through existing products and channels by developing account management tools. Maintain excellent relationships with each Playtech customer through regular communication and meetings. Coordinate the interface of Playtech’s project management, translation, finance, compliance, and legal processes with customer’s equivalent staff. Maintain detailed customer relationship information and share regularly with colleagues/management. Develop new marketing initiatives with customers. Maintain detailed information on Playtech competition in the online market for regular feedback into the team. Provide first-level business support and act as an escalation point for technical issues. Attend exhibitions and events. Conduct operational audits. Components for success. You... Are highly self-motivated and can work well autonomously. Possess a high level of emotional intelligence (EQ) and are passionate about the gaming industry. Have excellent written and spoken English, Spanish and Portuguese skills. Have experience managing or working with international and external customers. Have experience with a software or internet company in a relevant position. Are detail-oriented, self-managed, a team player, and capable of multitasking. Are service and business-oriented with excellent interpersonal skills. Have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Have knowledge of internet advertising (an advantage). Can prioritize and manage client engagements effectively. Have proven negotiation skills. Have a background in managing legal contracts and documents (an advantage). Have proven ability to manage multiple client relationships and grow revenues. Have an interest in and knowledge of sports, betting, casino games, and poker. Understand IT platforms, systems, and development processes. Are good with numbers. Have experience in the online gaming industry. Have at least 2 years of experience or background in Customer Services/Customer Support B2B. You'll get extra points for... Knowledge of internet advertising. Background in managing legal contracts and documents. Proven ability to manage multiple client relationships. Interest in and knowledge of sports, betting, casino games, and poker. Thrive in a culture that values... A competitive salary and bonus scheme. A fantastic team culture. Opportunities to work in the gaming industry with one of the top teams in the sector. Professional growth and educational development opportunities. An inclusive environment where differences are celebrated, and everyone is encouraged to be themselves at work. HOW TO APPLY? In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in account management or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under “your message to the hiring manager”). Account Manager Team Join our dynamic team and be part of a great business unit that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. Our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of the gaming industry and delivering exceptional results for our clients. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

items.title: Sales Director,  DACH
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2,400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world’s highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale Here’s the bit about the opportunity: As part of the Fireblocks sales team, you will play a meaningful role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the Blockchain and Cybersecurity field. You’ll target a mixture of Crypto-Native and Financial Services accounts in the DACH (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) region, working closely with Sales Engineers and the Business Development team. You’ll be: Achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets Working closely with the Fireblocks BDR and GTM Team Building and maintaining relationships with prospects and customers Prospect, territory, and account planning Updating and maintaining Fireblocks CRM You’ll bring: Enterprise sales experience in software or institutional sales, selling into a relevant space of financial services, crypto, blockchain or fintech Understanding of blockchain technology and cryptocurrency Direct experience working within financial services, cybersecurity, or cryptocurrency is preferred Track record of over-achievement Entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude with a willingness to prospect Worked in a team-selling environment We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for those who want to work with some of the industry’s most talented contributors. You should bring a track record of success and experience closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sector. For employees hired to work from the EU, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to Germany and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is €80,400 – €100,500. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

items.title: Senior Affiliates Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel. Your Responsibilities As our Senior Affiliate Manager DACH , you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships. End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management: Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets. Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"): Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks. Key Account Growth ("Farming"): Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised. Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion: Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products. Operational & Tracking Excellence: Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds). Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control: Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels. Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy: Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company. Your Profile Must-Haves Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region. Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends. Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes. Strong Interpersonal & Negotiation Skills: Excellent communication skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude and a strong commitment to team collaboration and problem-solving. Language Proficiency: Business fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is required to manage partner relationships and engage effectively within our international team. Nice-to-Haves FinTech & Financial Product Interest: Prior experience or strong curiosity regarding personal finance, banking products, investments, or pension topics. Tool Familiarity: Practical experience working with CRM and affiliate software platforms such as HubSpot, Impact, or similar enterprise partner management suites. AI & Automation Curiosity: Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to streamline routine partner communication, market research, or operational workflows. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Key Account Manager - Greece
items.description: Outstanding opportunity to join Betsson Group as our new Key Account Manager - Greece. Role Overview We are seeking a dynamic and customer-centric Key Account Manager to join our team in Malta. This role is pivotal in building strong relationships with our most valuable customers and ensuring a best-in-class service experience that drives loyalty, engagement, and revenue growth. items.title: Partner Account Manager - DACH
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. As Partner Account Manager you will help manage and execute the partnerships that accelerate Claude adoption, unlock new capabilities and drive outcomes for our joint customers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You will own a defined set of named partners end to end — a mix of (a) in-country DACH practices of our global system integrators (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, PwC, BCG), where you work hand in hand with the GSI alliance owners who hold the global relationships, and (b) regional system integrators, consultancies and AI-native boutiques that DACH enterprises and the Mittelstand actually buy from. The DACH partner book is split between you and the Head of Partnerships DACH and CEE; for every partner assigned to you, you own the plan, the enablement path, the co-sell motion with our DACH sales team and the partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline that results from it. This is a builder role: partner-sourced pipeline in DACH is still a small fraction of our open pipeline, and there is a first playbook but no established machine. We need someone who has taken partnerships from zero to a repeatable revenue engine in this market before, not someone who has inherited and administered an existing partner book. Key responsibilities Partner development and execution: Run each partner as a structured pursuit: stakeholder map (country lead, AI/data practice lead, alliance lead, key account partners), joint account plan, agreed target accounts and a quarterly cadence. For your assigned GSI country practices: activate the DACH teams against the global frameworks and translate them into concrete joint accounts. For your assigned regional SIs / boutiques: build the relationship from scratch (selection, onboarding into the Claude Partner Network, enablement, first joint deals). Guide partners in building repeatable Claude offerings (agentic engineering rollouts, agentic use cases, enterprise adoption programs) for the priority DACH industries: automotive and manufacturing, financial services and insurance, public sector, telco, pharma and chemicals. Drive co-selling with the DACH AEs, Applied AI and Technical Success teams: introduce partners into the right accounts, bring partner-sourced opportunities to sales, and make sure every partner-attached deal is tagged correctly in Salesforce. Performance and KPI ownership: Own and drive the KPIs for your portfolio: Partner delivered use-cases, partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, consultants enabled and certified, partners progressing through CPN tiers, joint proposals submitted. Establish clear success metrics with each partner and drive regular business reviews against targets Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights Every deal that runs through your partners must be set up for customer success and expansion: agree success criteria for joint accounts, make sure the partner delivers implementation and adoption support, and feed what you learn back into our partner program and the DACH sales team. Market development and brand building Represent Anthropic in the DACH partner ecosystem — partner events, joint customer events, and partner-led marketing in German. Adapt the global partner playbook to DACH buying behaviour (Mittelstand vs. DAX/SMI enterprises, long procurement cycles, works councils, preference for local delivery partners) and decide deliberately what not to copy. Navigate the regulatory and sovereignty topics that come up in almost every DACH deal (GDPR, EU AI Act, data residency, regulated industries such as banking and insurance) together with the partner and our internal experts. Build differentiated joint value propositions with partners so that Claude is the default recommendation of the DACH consulting ecosystem. You may be a good fit if you have: Builder mentality — comfortable starting from a small base and turning it into a scaled partner business; you enjoy doing the work yourself. 8+ years of partner / alliances / channel experience with system integrators and consultancies in DACH, ideally at a cloud, data or AI platform company. Existing relationships in the DACH practices of the large SIs and/or with the regional consultancies and boutiques — you know who runs the AI and data practices in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Data-driven, KPI-oriented and comfortable being measured on partner-sourced pipeline; a track record of driving incremental revenue through partners in DACH. History of protecting the customer experience and the brand through partners — you say no to partners that cannot deliver. Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation Collaborative — you work as an extension of the DACH sales team and with Applied AI, Technical Success, partner marketing and the global GSI alliance owners. Business-fluent German (C1+ / native) and English; able to run partner executive conversations and enablement sessions in German. Based in Germany and willing to travel regularly within DE / AT / CH and occasionally to London and San Francisco. Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development Working Relationships You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our DACH and CEE Partnerships leader who is based in Munich. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Technical Account Management teams. Location and Travel Based in Germany, ideally Munich; Berlin or Frankfurt are possible with regular time in Munich and with the sales team. Regular travel to partners and customers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, plus occasional travel to London (partner leadership) and San Francisco (onboarding). The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €160.000 — €220.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Sales Director, Payments (DACH)
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale Here’s the bit about the opportunity: Joining the EMEA Fireblocks sales team, you will drive growth for Fireblocks within blockchain payments sector in the DACH region. As a key member of a leading blockchain and cybersecurity firm, you will target PSP, Cross-Border, Remittances and various other payment providers whilst collaborating closely with regional sales teams, Sales Engineers, and the Payments product team. You’ll be: Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Collaborating with the Fireblocks BDR and GTM teams to generate and qualify leads. Building and nurturing strong relationships with prospects and customers. Conducting prospecting, territory, and account planning to identify new opportunities. Keeping the Fireblocks CRM up-to-date with accurate account and pipeline information. You’ll bring: Enterprise SaaS or institutional sales experience, selling into the Payments space Passion for blockchain technology and cryptocurrency Experience within financial services, cybersecurity, or cryptocurrency is preferred Experience in formalising and supporting the co-sell motion in working with technology partners is preferred Track record of over-achievement in an enterprise sales position Entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude A willingness to prospect and qualify for new opportunities Thrives in a team-selling environment We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for A players who want to work with the best. Track record of success and closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sectors For employees hired to work from the EU, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to Germany and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is €80,400 – €100,500. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Account Executive in Spanish Latam who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals 2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency 3. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends 4. Demonstrate expertise—or a strong willingness to learn—about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more REQUIREMENTS - 3–5+ years of sales experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API platforms - Experience selling technical solutions to product, engineering, or innovation teams is a strong plus - Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment - Expertise or willingness to learn everything about voice and audio AI and how our solutions can help prospects - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization - A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale - Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in Chile, with preference for Santiago or Lima. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Manager, Revenue Planning and Analytics
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. As the market leader in sports technology, Sportradar (NASDAQ: SRAD) is positioned at the center of the sports ecosystem. Our broader Financial Planning & Analysis organization plays a critical role in delivering extraordinary growth; we’re targeting a 15% CAGR for revenue while consistently expanding margin and cash conversion. In an industry where AI is redefining fan engagement, our finance leaders must be as sophisticated as our technology: combining financial discipline with commercial acumen and advanced analytics to unlock opportunities across a market growing at double-digit percent annually. THE CHALLENGE Reporting to the VP of Revenue Performance & Planning, you are the primary performance auditor of commercial outcomes. You don't just report numbers; you interrogate them and recommend the way forward to maximize value. Your mission is to identify the "why" behind performance trends that you package to a compelling story to drive a business decision. You provide the critical challenge required for driving revenue and margin, guiding business counterparts through a transformative planning process that prioritizes drivers over pure outcomes. Proactive revenue performance analysis: move past outcomes to identify the specific revenue drivers (e.g., usage, churn, pricing, market) that management must focus on. Revenue forecast pressure-testing: Interrogate the inputs that feed our global P&L to ensure every forecast is achievable and rooted in actionable drivers. Logic refinement: Identify and dismantle broken assumptions in commercial plans and rebuild them into actionable, robust frameworks. Causal synthesis: Translate complex technical and commercial data into clear, authoritative narratives for senior stakeholders. Key responsibilities Driver autopsy: Conduct deep-dives into revenue beats or misses to distinguish between one-time windfalls and core structural trends. Planning guidance: Lead commercial counterparts through the forecasting and budgeting process to ensure submissions are robust and logically sound. Business modeling: Create elegant solutions for complex business topics like pricing elasticity and market entry costs. Build automated revenue reporting using advanced analytical and reporting tools on top of data warehouse and billing data sets to steer commercial decision making ABOUT YOU You ask smart questions and refuse to accept surface-level explanations. You enable business success by providing the "so-what" that others miss. You are a "fixer" who enjoys the challenge of untangling messy data problems to find a clear path forward. What we're looking for Experience : 3-5 years in a multidisciplinary finance, analytics, and/or consulting role. Archetype : We seek high proficiency in either commercial finance or commercial analytics. Education : MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred. Technical requirement : SQL, Power BI / Tableau, and AI agents knowledge is essential. Experience with Python or n8n/workflow automation is highly valued. Mindset : An "accountability" mindset - you value the strength of a plan over the speed of its delivery. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment : Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Account Executive in Spanish Latam who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals 2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency 3. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends 4. Demonstrate expertise—or a strong willingness to learn—about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more REQUIREMENTS - 3–5 years of sales experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API platforms - Experience selling technical solutions to product, engineering, or innovation teams is a strong plus - Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment - Expertise or willingness to learn everything about voice and audio AI and how our solutions can help prospects - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization - A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale - Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, we prefer candidates based in Mexico. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Strategic Business Development Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're seeking a business development lead to own Anthropic's BD partnership footprint with a small number of the world's largest and most consequential technology companies. These are not single-threaded accounts. Each relationship spans many businesses at once — consumer products, devices and operating systems, productivity and collaboration software, cloud and developer platforms, commerce, and enterprise distribution. Your job is to see the whole board, decide where Anthropic should lean in and where it shouldn't, and turn that judgment into signed deals. The center of gravity for this role is product and distribution partnerships: co-developing opportunities with partners, and structuring the commercial, technical, and go-to-market terms that make those partnerships durable. You'll typically be running several deal streams inside the same partner in parallel — at different stages, with different counterparts, and with terms that interact with one another — and you'll be the person responsible for keeping them coherent. This is an individual contributor role for a seasoned dealmaker who is comfortable as the primary counterpart to senior executives at very large companies, who brings strong judgment to ambiguous, high-stakes situations, and who can carry a complex, multi-party negotiation from first conversation through signature and into execution. Key responsibilities Manage a small number of large, multi-faceted partner relationships end to end: set the strategy for each relationship, decide which opportunities to pursue and in what order, and stay accountable for the overall health and commercial output of the partnership across every surface it touches Lead product partnerships: identify and structure opportunities to embed Claude in partners' consumer and enterprise products, co-develop new products and features, and define the product, technical, data, and brand terms that come with them, working closely with Anthropic's product and engineering leaders Run multiple deal streams in parallel: manage several concurrent negotiations within the same partner — product integrations, distribution and go-to-market, commercial and consumption agreements, and infrastructure — and sequence and connect them so terms in one stream reinforce rather than undercut the others Negotiate complex, first-of-kind agreements: lead end-to-end negotiations involving novel commercial structures, revenue and economics sharing, product and roadmap commitments, exclusivity and competitive provisions, data terms, and multi-year, multi-component value exchanges Act as an executive counterpart: build and manage relationships with senior executives and their teams on the partner side, serve as Anthropic's primary voice into the partnership, and prepare and steer Anthropic's own executives through partner-level engagements Exercise judgment on behalf of Anthropic: weigh commercial upside against strategic, competitive, product, and mission considerations; know when to say no; and make clear, well-reasoned recommendations to Anthropic leadership on trade-offs that don't have a playbook Drive cross-functional execution: coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Policy across the life of a partnership, from initial structuring through negotiation, launch, and ongoing governance, ensuring what we sign is something Anthropic can deliver Minimum qualifications Direct experience owning a large, multi-business partner relationship, where you were responsible for the whole relationship rather than a single deal or product line Track record of structuring and closing product partnerships — embedding technology into partner products, co-developed products, distribution through partner surfaces, or similar — in addition to conventional commercial agreements Experience personally leading complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with senior executives, including deals with interlocking terms, competitive sensitivities, and multi-year commitments Demonstrated ability to manage several significant negotiations at the same time without losing the thread on any of them Experience coordinating cross-functional execution (e.g., Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance) to bring a complex agreement from structuring through signature and delivery Preferred qualifications 10+ years in strategic business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development at technology companies, with meaningful time spent managing relationships with very large technology partners Experience on either side of a partnership between a foundation model or AI platform provider and a large technology company Experience working inside one of the very large technology companies, with a practical understanding of how decisions get made, who holds budget and roadmap authority, and how to navigate them Experience with partnerships that span both consumer and enterprise businesses, or that combine product, distribution, and infrastructure components in a single relationship Understanding of foundation model capabilities and how they translate into partner products, with enough technical fluency to work credibly with product and engineering leaders on both sides Background in corporate development, strategy, or a legal or finance discipline involving structuring and papering unusually complex agreements The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Head of Paid Media
items.description: Grandstand (Nasdaq: GRSD) is the intelligence layer of sports, gaming and entertainment. We build the brands people trust, the data our partners depend on, and the technology this industry runs with exceptional people, not shortcuts. OpticOdds delivers enterprise-grade data infrastructure to B2B partners worldwide, while OddsJam and RotoWire put that same real-time intelligence directly into the hands of consumers. On the gaming and entertainment side, our portfolio includes some of the biggest names in the space: Gambling.com , Casinos.com , Spotlight.Vegas , and WhichBingo.co.uk — flagship sites reaching millions of consumers every month. We're the first, and only, U.S. publicly traded company of our kind, and the first company to win EGR's Affiliate of the Year three times. We hold every hire to the same five standards: Taste, Agency, Speed, Craft, Responsibility. Built for what's next. Ready to build with us? About the Role We're looking for a senior Head of Paid Media to lead the strategy and execution of our paid acquisition engine, spanning SEM, paid social, native, programmatic, and affiliate/partner marketing. This is a high-impact leadership role with direct ownership of a significant paid media budget and full accountability for the volume, quality, and efficiency of the customers we acquire . You'll build and scale a high-performing team, drive rigorous testing and attribution discipline across channels, and act as the paid acquisition voice in cross-functional planning with Product, Analytics, CRM, and Commercial teams, while ensuring every campaign meets regulatory and responsible gaming standards across all jurisdictions we operate in. What You'll Do Lead the development and execution of multi-channel paid acquisition strategy, SEM, paid social, native, programmatic, and affiliate/partner marketing, to drive high-value customer acquisition at scale Own the paid media budget end-to-end, building a portfolio-based approach to spend allocation that dynamically shifts investment across channels to maximize ROI against aggressive performance and revenue targets Evaluate and scale performance marketing campaigns through rigorous testing, data analysis, and attribution modeling to continuously improve efficiency and growth Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of acquisition, channel, and affiliate/partner leads, fostering a culture of accountability, creativity, and excellence Partner closely with CRM, Product, SEO, Content, Analytics, and Commercial teams to ensure paid acquisition strategy aligns with lifecycle, retention, and broader revenue goals Drive innovation and experimentation, testing new tools, partners, channels, and creative approaches to stay ahead in a competitive paid and affiliate marketing landscape Leverage marketing analytics and user insights to identify growth opportunities and report on channel and campaign KPIs to senior leadership Manage relationships with key media partners, agencies, and affiliate networks, while building internal capability to reduce reliance on external vendors Ensure all paid acquisition and affiliate marketing activity complies with regulatory and responsible gaming standards across all applicable jurisdictions and platforms Serve as a key strategic partner to the business , contributing paid acquisition expertise to broader marketing and growth strategy What We're Looking For 8–10+ years in performance marketing, paid media, or affiliate marketing, including 3+ years leading teams of 6 or more Proven ownership of a significant media budget (ideally $10M+ annually) across multiple paid and partner channels Deep expertise across at least two of: SEM, paid social, programmatic, native, affiliate/partner marketing Experience in regulated industries (gaming, betting, fintech, or insurance) strongly preferred, with familiarity navigating responsible gaming or compliance requirements a plus Strong command of attribution modeling , testing frameworks, and marketing analytics to inform channel-level decisions Track record of building in-house performance marketing capability and reducing dependency on external agencies Excellent cross-functional leadership, able to align paid acquisition strategy with CRM/retention, product, and commercial priorities Comfortable operating as a senior voice in marketing strategy discussions, with the judgment to flag risk and opportunity to leadership Perks & Benefits Comprehensive private Healthcare Insurance Flexible work environment and home office available Home office allowance Gym & Leisure Allowance All the hardware and software you need to be items.description: [Full-time] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to own paid user acquisition end to end. You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable. This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit. Key Responsibilities Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it. Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue. Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy—and flag it loudly when they aren't Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight Requirements 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)—you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations—you know when a number is directional vs. reliable Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume Demonstrated CRO instincts and experience partnering on landing page and funnel testing Clear written communication—you can explain performance and tradeoffs to a leadership audience without a translator Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you set your own priorities Salary Range $140,000 – $175,000 + Equity + Performance Based Bonus - DOE We want to be as inclusive as possible in our hiring process. If you don’t have 100% of what we’re looking for, but feel like you’re pretty close to growing into the role — please still apply. If a candidate has only 80% of the skills but a fantastic attitude and perspective, they might be the perfect fit. Boldin values the unique perspectives and contributions of all individuals and we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including and not limited to people of any race, ethnicity, or national origin, individuals with differing abilities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, veterans, gender minorities, women and people from underrepresented communities.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with differing abilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodations, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. We are committed to fostering an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you are comfortable doing so we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application. #LI-REMOTE

Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Strategic Account Executive to drive new business and growth within our largest enterprise prospects by developing tailored strategies to break into and expand major accounts. This role demands sophisticated account research, executive-level messaging, and champion-building to address customer pain points and priority business outcomes. items.title: Affiliate Manager
items.description: Work with the Best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold – concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network Orderly's affiliate manager is responsible for building and managing a company's affiliate program, including recruiting new affiliates, maintaining relationships with existing ones, and negotiating contracts: What will you be working on? Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the affiliate marketing landscape, including industry trends, emerging technologies, and key players in the crypto and blockchain space. Identify, source, and onboard the right set of affiliate partners to align with the company's product goals and business strategy. Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with top affiliates globally, ensuring long-term partnerships and mutual success. Manage and optimize relationships with existing affiliates and clients, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with business objectives. Collaborate with affiliate partners and internal teams to design and implement campaigns; work closely with Product and Engineering teams to address affiliate needs and ensure seamless integration and execution. Who will you be working with? Maintain close collaboration with the Marketing , Operations , Product , and Business Development teams to ensure cohesive strategies and streamlined processes. About you The ability to build relationships and manage a diverse community The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Knowledge of affiliate networks Exceptional planning and project management skills Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.
